expected_symptom: cmake --build --target install fails with 'file INSTALL cannot find <build>/<config>/bin/llvm-as.exe: File exists' from tools/llvm-as/cmake_install.cmake, surfaced by MSBuild as MSB3073, on a default (HLSL_OPTIONAL_PROJS_IN_DEFAULT=OFF) configuration.
godbolt_skip: Compiler Explorer compiles a single HLSL source and cannot configure or install a CMake build; this issue has no shader repro at all. Evidence is a static read of the CMake rule graph, per notes.md.
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Plain 'install' target unconditionally installs llvm-as (add_llvm_tool's install(TARGETS) rule, cmake/modules/AddLLVM.cmake), but llvm-as is excluded from the default build by HLSL_OPTIONAL_PROJS_IN_DEFAULT=OFF (tools/llvm-as/CMakeLists.txt), so cmake_install.cmake fails to find an executable that was never built. Unchanged in source from before this issue was filed (18328d510) through the ground-truth commit. Confirmed by maintainer-closed duplicate #5867 ('llvm-as ... was never built'). install-distribution (added pre-issue, PR #5154) sidesteps this via per-component install targets and already works, but is undocumented outside CMakeLists.txt/CI.
title: Install error
